keyPoints: Lamb vrittakar shanku (cone) ka vakr prishthiya = πrl, kul = πr(l+r), aaytan = (1/3)πr²h — jahan l tiryak unchai hai, topi iska udaharan hai — birthday cap ya joker ki topi.
Tiryak unchai l = √(r² + h²) — pehle l nikaalo, phir sutra lagao; bina l ke prishthiya nahi niklega.
Gole (sphere) ka prishthiya = 4πr², aaytan = (4/3)πr³; ardh-gole ka vakr = 2πr², kul = 3πr² — gend, santra.
Shanku ka aaytan same aadhar-unchai wale belan ka ek-tihai hota hai — teen shanku ka aaytan ek belan barabar.
Belan ka vakr prishthiya 2πrh aur aaytan πr²h — kaksha 8 se yaad rakho, pipe aur drum isi se.
Khokhle gole ka aaytan = bahari gole - andaruni gole ka aaytan — khol ki motai ka dhyan rakho.
Aam galti: shanku me h ki jagah l rakhna ya ulta — aaytan me seedhi unchai h, prishthiya me tiryak unchai l lagti hai.
subject: Maths
title: Shanku, Gola: Prishthiya aur Aaytan
